_readme: Curated Shopify storefronts for ingest-shopify.mjs. Every Shopify store
exposes a public, unauthenticated product feed at /products.json — title,
price, availability, and the FULL image gallery. No API key, no approval.
IMPORTANT — fetch from the INTERNAL *.myshopify.com host, not the custom
domain: headless storefronts (Gymshark, Fashion Nova) block or drop
/products.json on their custom domain, but the internal address serves it.
Find a brand's internal host with:  node ingest-shopify.mjs --discover
https://brand.com  (it greps the homepage source for myshopify.com).
store = the public storefront origin (outbound product links users see)
Probe results (Jul 2026, from cloud egress): all five feeds 200 with
3-10-image galleries. dior.com is NOT on Shopify (503, no internal host)
and was dropped. Politeness: 250 products/request, throttled, 429-aware.
